in_marathi.name: Dharv
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Shining, Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dharv is derived from the Sanskrit language and translates to 'Radiant', 'Shining', or 'Dharma'. In Hindu mythology, Dharma refers to moral duties and ethical conduct. A name bestowed upon a child to instill virtues of truth, righteousness, and morality.
